routes only touch joystick movement through calibration while preserving keyboard and pointer movement rules
upgrades player combat readability with stronger floor shadow, focus halo, silhouette glow and slightly larger default base scale
brightens the glass UI palette, panel highlights and scene chrome to reduce dullness and visual clutter
adds a settings shortcut for joystick correction alongside existing FPS, graphics, accessibility and QA controls
preserves Firebase App Check disabled state, player art variants, QA analysis, haptics, announcements and layered combat audio
adds v1.11.4 cumulative release validation for direction calibration, UI refinement and player visual polish

verification: release-version validation runs before the main verification chain
v1.10 through v1.11.4 cumulative validators protect mobile, accessibility, recovery, combat, graphics, input, player art variants and QA analysis contracts
touch joystick calibration defaults to reverse correction and can cycle through screen, invert-x and invert-y modes
player presentation now includes floor shadow, focus halo, silhouette glow and overdrive tint without changing cloud-save contracts
scene chrome and panel helpers render with the brighter v1.11.4 palette and updated contrast rules
all TypeScript sources are syntax-parsed with the available compiler and all static release validators pass
full and patch archives are extracted and compared by SHA-256 against the v1.11.4 working tree
